deeper.title: What the price assumes
deeper.text: Not meaningful. Free cash flow has been negative or unavailable over the last 3 years, so there is no cash base to project.

deeper.title: Return on capital
deeper.text: -1% — each $100 invested in the business (debt + equity, net of cash) earns about $-1 a year after tax; return on shareholders' equity -38%. (Tax rate estimated at 21%: effective rate not reported.)

deeper.title: Signed future revenue
deeper.text: Signed but not yet delivered (remaining performance obligations): $103.7B, up 245% from a year ago — about 13.7× the last 12 months of sales; customer prepayments not yet earned (deferred revenue): $9.7B, up 102% from a year ago.

deeper.title: Cash returned to shareholders
deeper.text: No buybacks or dividends reported over the last 12 months. Share count up 13.1% from a year ago (stock pay outpacing buybacks — dilution).

deeper.title: Analyst estimates
deeper.text: Next year's earnings-per-share estimate $-4.70; 2 analysts raised, 6 cut in 30 days. This year's earnings-per-share estimate $-5.19; 2 analysts raised, 6 cut in 30 days. Source: Yahoo (unofficial).

deeper.title: Where sales come from
deeper.text: By region, latest quarter vs a year earlier: US 93% of sales, up 108%; All other countries 7% of sales, up 191%. Source: 10-Q XBRL.

tiles.title: Earnings per share
tiles.read: It is losing money per share; earnings can't support the price yet, so the story rests on future profits.
tiles.explain: EPS = profit divided by the number of shares. The quarterly figures are the 'adjusted' EPS analysts track (Yahoo); the 12-month figure is the official GAAP number from SEC filings.

tiles.title: Earnings vs forecasts
tiles.sub: last 6 reports · bars = EPS beat (+) or miss (−) vs the average forecast
tiles.read: A mixed record: 2 beats in the last 6 quarters, so results are hard to predict.
tiles.explain: A 'beat' means reported EPS came in above the average analyst forecast. Source: Yahoo (unofficial).

tiles.title: Sales growth
tiles.read: Sales up 112% from a year ago, about as fast as two quarters ago (110%): steady demand.
tiles.explain: Growth of quarterly sales (revenue) compared with the same quarter a year earlier.

tiles.title: Profit margins
tiles.read: Operating margin -3%: it spends more to run the business than it earns from sales.
tiles.explain: Operating margin = operating profit ÷ sales. Gross margin = what's left after the direct cost of the product.

tiles.title: Free cash flow
tiles.read: Free cash flow is negative: it's spending more (often on new capacity) than the business brings in.
tiles.explain: Free cash flow = cash from operations minus spending on equipment and buildings: money the company could return or reinvest.

tiles.title: Price vs profits (P/E)
tiles.read: P/E isn't meaningful: earnings over the last 12 months were negative or missing.
tiles.explain: P/E = share price ÷ earnings per share: how many years of today's profit you pay for.

tiles.title: Next earnings
tiles.read: Reports Nov 10; analysts expect EPS of $-1.21. It usually moves about 15% the day after, so expect a swing.
tiles.explain: Consensus = the average analyst forecast (Yahoo, unofficial). The typical move is the average size of the stock's next-day move after its last reports, not an options-implied figure.

tiles.title: Company outlook
tiles.read: No numeric outlook was found in the latest earnings release, so the next report carries more surprise risk.
tiles.explain: Guidance = what management says it expects for the next quarter or year, from its 8-K earnings release.
